author: Ubisoft
description:
With Dawn of the Delta, there's much more to discover beyond the borders of Latium. From welcoming new residents to harnessing the power of the Nile, explore the new mechanics that will shape your journey in Aegyptus.
 
But that's not all! Update 3.0 brings new features to Anno 117: Pax Romana, including the highly requested Stamp Feature and an expanded Statistics Menu.
 
There's plenty to discover, Governor. Are you ready to shape the future of Aegyptus?

About Anno 117: Pax Romana:
In the latest instalment of the award-winning Anno strategy franchise, it’s your destiny to shape the Roman Empire in the year 117 AD. As governor, will you encourage economic growth or expand your rule through dominance? Lead with rebellion or unite a diverse culture? 
The cost of peace is yours to decide.

Learn more about Ubisoft: www.ubisoftgroup.com
